services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: The Best School Field Trips in Cleveland! Duration 2 hours About 2024 Marks the 66th Consecutive Season that GOODTIME III is offering one of the best field trips in Cleveland with this educational excursion on the Cuyahoga River. The tour offers a first-hand look at the river and ports and teaches students about the history, social studies, and economics of the area. It’s a field trip that school groups will remember for the rest of their lives! Field trips are available from the second week of May through the first week of June. services.name: Narrated Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: A unique and spectacular two-hour narrated cruise along the Cuyahoga River and Lake Erie! Duration 2 hours About Any list of the top things to do in Cleveland has to include a sightseeing cruise on the Goodtime III! This two-hour narrated cruise along the Cuyahoga River and Lake Erie provides an in-depth look at Cleveland’s history and provides spectacular views of downtown Cleveland, the Flats, and all of the surrounding areas. Passengers will enjoy the quickly changing panorama of Cleveland’s skyline and listen to the narrator point out many sights and little-known historical facts about this All-American city. services.desc: The Best Spot to Dance on Friday & Saturday Nights in Cleveland!
